clips.text: When I say mutation I do not mean simply change.
Change is from the known to the known.
A sinner becomes a saint - then it is change and not mutation.

You can practice change but you cannot practice mutation because only the known can be practiced - and then any change is going to be only a modified past because the past will be continuous in it, and the past also will be the master of it because it is cultivated by the past.
In other words, change is from this to that, it is a movement in the known.
But mutation is an explosion: from this to nothingness, from here to nowhere You cannot practice it - on the contrary, you are the only hindrance.
So what is to be done?
Be aware of this helplessness, and remain in this helplessness.
